i0-context.title: Load baseline context
i0-context.imperative: Load LAUNCH_ORDER_446.md, issue #446 text, the governing spec, glossary, preprocessing/physics packets. Confirm cache + DB data availability. Record pass when loaded.

q1-capability.title: What capability is being added?
q1-capability.imperative: Resolve the present-tense capability. RESOLVED by launch order: a permanent, read-only trajectory grading harness that scores any candidate per-lap trajectory product s(t)+covariance against (a) sector-anchor gate, (b) covariance-consistency gate, (c) cross-residual diagnostic, emits a machine-readable JSON report, with unit-tested scoring primitives. No estimator work; runs against a trivial strawman to prove it discriminates.

q2-strawman.title: What is the strawman candidate?
q2-strawman.imperative: RESOLVED by pre-ruling 2 (exception): the strawman deliberately wraps FastF1's merged/interpolated get_telemetry() product as a 'trajectory' — the artifact-under-study — to prove the harness discriminates. The harness itself consumes only raw car_data/pos_data; the strawman is the one place the merged product is allowed.

q3-anchor-calibration.title: How are sector-loop anchor positions handled?
q3-anchor-calibration.imperative: RESOLVED by pre-ruling 5: sector-loop positions along the ribbon are NOT published; the scoring API must treat anchor arc-length positions as per-circuit calibration parameters (estimated/supplied inputs with uncertainty), never hard-coded constants. Open sub-question for plan: how does the harness obtain candidate anchor positions for the strawman run (co-estimate vs supply)? Commander latitude (implementation structure within physics region).

q4-report-schema.title: What report schema + where does code live?
q4-report-schema.imperative: RESOLVED by pre-rulings 3 & 7: shipping code in src/preprocessing/ (new submodule), exploration in scripts/. Machine-readable JSON report with a stable, documented schema (producer + schema doc together per repo policy -> docs/report_schemas/). No imports from evo. Schema details are Commander latitude.

q5-session-selection.title: Which >=3 sessions for the strawman run?
q5-session-selection.imperative: RESOLVED by pre-ruling 8: prefer 2022-2025 (deep cache), >=1 race and >=1 quali, document choice. Selection is Commander latitude. Verified available: e.g. 2023 Belgium R/Q load offline with raw streams.

q6-honest-null.title: Is a negative result acceptable?
q6-honest-null.imperative: RESOLVED by Honest-Null clause: a measured negative on the stated question (e.g. sector-anchor scoring cannot discriminate at ~50ms with unpublished loop positions) is a complete, successful deliverable, reported with the same rigor as a win. Feeds 0b's gate.

q7-residual-ambiguity.title: Any residual ambiguity requiring the Admiral?
q7-residual-ambiguity.imperative: Surface anything genuinely unresolved that crosses Commander latitude and needs the Admiral before planning. Record findings.

consolidation.verdict: Ask fully resolved by launch order; no residual ambiguity requiring the Admiral before planning. All open sub-questions fall within Commander latitude.
